message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Overview** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• On highways: 55–75 mph (often 70 mph).
• On rural roads: 55 mph.
• On city streets: 25–35 mph.
• Exceeding limits can lead to fines, points, and possible license suspension. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat or booster.
• Failure to buckle up can result in a $50 fine and 1 point. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed.
• Violations carry a $50 fine and 1 point. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal.
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, mandatory alcohol‑abuse treatment, and possible jail time.
• First offense: up to 90 days in jail, $500 fine, 90‑day license suspension. | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red light = stop; green = go; yellow = prepare to stop.
• Stop signs require a full stop.
• Failure to obey can lead to fines and points. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the vehicle on the right has the right of way.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in fire lanes, bus stops, or within 20 ft of a crosswalk.
• Parking in a handicap space without a valid permit is a $200 fine. | | **Points System** | • Points are added for violations (e.g., 1 point for speeding 1–10 mph over limit).
• 12 points in 12 months can lead to license suspension. | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage.
• Failure to maintain insurance can result in license suspension. | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Trucks over 10,000 lb must have a commercial driver’s license (CDL).
• Bicyclists must obey traffic signals and ride in the lane when possible. | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Failure to stop can result in a $200 fine and 1 point. | ### How to Stay Informed - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official rules and updates. - **Texas Transportation Code** – Legal text for detailed provisions. - **Local DMV** – For licensing, insurance, and penalty information. If you need specific statutes or recent changes, let me know!
